newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemen, Eritrea to sign an arbitration agreement over disputed islands on Thursday.
- Riyadh governor Prince Salman to inaugurate a power project in the Saudi capital on Sunday.
- Saudi, Egypt plan to set up a 50 million Egyptian pound tourism project on the Red Sea.
- Algeria's economy is expected to grow five percent in 1996.
- Iraqi foreign minister says Baghdad will not retreat from rejecting no-fly zones.
- United Arab Emirates' exports to the United States and Gulf Arab states in 1995 worth $1.35 billion.
